heading: Spa & Wellness
philosophy: Conceived in perfect symbiosis with its natural surroundings, The Ylang Ylang maintains a philosophy of living life with passion and serenity — 'Passionate Serenity'. Offering yoga and spa treatments alongside fresh, wholesome food, this therapeutic spot helps balance mind, body and soul.
spa: The extensive in-house spa menu features local and Indonesian treatments such as Balinese massage, mandi lulur and cream baths, plus facials, pedicures and manicures. Treatments, administered by outsourced professional therapists, can be enjoyed on the rooftop massage deck (two massage beds), within guestrooms, in the beachfront gazebo, or any other suitable setting. Staff arrange appointments in advance.
yoga: The powerful spiritual vibe and glorious setting are conducive to yoga and meditation. The owners have years of expertise, curating renowned yoga instructors and visiting yoga masters for private villa sessions. Yoga mats are provided, with peaceful places to practise such as the river deck or rooftop yoga deck at dawn or sunset. Traditional Balinese healers can visit for personalised health and cleansing ceremonies.
blackSand: Even the volcanic black sands on the beach offer therapeutic qualities — rich in minerals, locals are known to bury themselves in the sand here to maximise its healing properties.
